paite: Huchi in ka dak nawn a, ngai in, tang nih kikal a kipan in kangtalai li a hong paikhia ua, huai tangte dal tang ahi uhi.
heading: Kangtalai Leh Sakolte Muhna
english: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.

paite: Kangtalai khat in sakol san anei ua kangtalai nihna in sakol vom;
english: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses.

paite: kangtalai thumna in sakol ngou; kangtalai lina in sakol puang hat anei uhi.
english: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.

paite: Huan kei hon houpih angel ka dong a akiang ah, "Hiaite bang ahi ua, ka toupa?" ka chi hi.
english: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”

paite: Angel in ahon dawng a, ka kiang ah, "Hiaite van huih lite, leitung pumpi Toupa ma a va dingh khin a paikhete ahi uh.
english: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

paite: Sakol vomte omna kangtalai mallam gam ah apaikhia ua; amau zui in angoute tumlam ah apawtkhia ua; apuangte simlam zuan in apawtkhia uhi."
english: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”

paite: Huan sakolte apaikhia ua, lei kantan a avialvak theihna ding uh angaklah uhi. Ama'n, "Hiai a kipan pai unla, lei kantan in vialvak un,” achi a, huchi in lei kantan in avialvak uhi.
english: The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth. He said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.

paite: Huchi in ahon sam a, ka kiang ah thu agen a, "Ngai in, mallam gam zuan a paite'n mallam gam ah ka kha akhawlsakta uh," achi hi.
english: Then he called to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Behold, those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
heading: Siampu Lian Joshua Lallukhu Khuksakna
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: Babulon a kipan saltang hong pai Heldai, Tobijah leh Jedaiah a pan thilpiak la in; ani mah in pai inla, Zephaniah tapa Josiah inn ah lut in.
english: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.

paite: Ahi, amau a kipan dangka leh dangka-eng la inla, kumpi lukhute bawl in, Jehozadak tapa Joshua, siampu lianpen luzang ah khusak in.
english: Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;

paite: Huan akiang ah thu gen inla, huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Ngai in, mi amin Kahiang: amun a kipan ahong kakhe ding a, ama'n TOUPA tempul alam ding hi.
english: and speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “Behold, the man whose name is the Branch! He will grow up out of his place; and he will build Yahweh’s temple.

paite: Ama'n TOUPA tempul alam ding a, thupina silhsak in a-om ding a, alaltutphah tung ah atu dia, vai ahawm ding; alaltutphah tung ah siampu ahi ding; huchi in amau gel kikal ah lemna thuhilhna a-om ding hi.
english: He will build Yahweh’s temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.

paite: Kumpi lukhute Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah leh Zephaniah tapa Hen kiang ah, TOUPA tempul atheihgigena ding in a-om ding uhi.
english: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in Yahweh’s temple.

paite: Huan gamlapi a omte ahong pai ding ua TOUPA tempul ahong lampih ding ua, huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang a kei hon sawl ahi chih na thei ding hi. Huchi in hiai ahong tung ding, TOUPA na Pathian aw pilvangtak a na man uleh, achi, chi in.
english: Those who are far off shall come and build in Yahweh’s temple; and you shall know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you. This will happen, if you will diligently obey Yahweh your God’s voice.”’”
